C0326.title: Hackers colluded with telecom employees to register and resell WeChat accounts, involving millions in illicit gains
C0326.summary: An employee surnamed Liu at a Guizhou subsidiary of a telecom group exploited his position to build a covert channel within the company's industry gateway system. Collaborating with others, he enabled large numbers of unregistered, inactive mobile numbers to pass SMS verification and successfully register WeChat accounts.
